name: 84062 · Pleasant Grv, UT
findings: ZIP 84062 (Pleasant Grv) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84062 (Pleasant Grv) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
